name: training-ui-pet-recovery
description: Verify displayed effective-Power training eligibility, compact contextual action presentation, unsupported-rig equipped-fist fallback, dense Inventory cards, distinct Robux pricing, and eight pack plus three detailed Premium pet visuals on iPhone 17 landscape.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='QC Training UI Pet Recovery 874x402' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=874,Height=402,PixelDensity=460,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Phone} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetOrientationAsync(Enum.ScreenOrientation.LandscapeLeft) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local folder=RS:FindFirstChild('PunchWallExternalAssets') local names={'Sanitized_ForestPupPet','Sanitized_MinerCatPet','Sanitized_CrystalFoxPet','Sanitized_LavaDragonPet','Sanitized_SecretTitanGolemPet','Sanitized_EnragedPhoenixPet','Sanitized_ElectraHydraPet','Sanitized_MythicRadiantOnePet','Sanitized_CrimsonPhoenixPet','Sanitized_StormWyvernPet','Sanitized_CelestialGuardianPet'} local found=0 for _,name in ipairs(names) do if folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name) then found+=1 end end local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({ok=found==11 and r.X==874 and r.Y==402,found=found,width=r.X,height=r.Y,active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id})

steps.label: configure iPhone 17 and require eight pack plus three detailed Premium templates
wait for device simulator to settle
start focused play
wait for player UI and pet attestation

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation a:Invoke('Reset') a:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=1400,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0,Rebirths=0,FistMastery=1,HonorPowerBonus=0}) a:Invoke('Teleport','Iron Impact Dummy') task.wait(.25) local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local s=a:Invoke('TrainingSnapshot') return H:JSONEncode({ok=s.ok==true and s.qualificationPower<1500 and root:GetAttribute('PetVisualReleaseReady')==true and root:GetAttribute('PetVisualReadyTemplateCount')==11,power=s.Power,qualification=s.qualificationPower,active=s.active,petReady=root:GetAttribute('PetVisualReleaseReady'),petCount=root:GetAttribute('PetVisualReadyTemplateCount'),policy=root:GetAttribute('PetVisualReleasePolicy')})

steps.label: seed truly below-threshold displayed Power and prove pet release readiness
wait for exact training target scan

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation local b=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD.ContextAction local title=b.ActionTitle local detail=b.ActionDetail local invoked=a:Invoke('InvokeContextualAction') local result={action=g:GetAttribute('ContextualActionName'),target=g:GetAttribute('ContextualActionTarget'),eligible=g:GetAttribute('ContextualTrainingEligible'),presentation=b:GetAttribute('PresentationVersion'),profile=b:GetAttribute('ResponsiveProfile'),title=title.Text,detail=detail.Text,titleFits=title.TextFits,detailFits=detail.TextFits,width=b.AbsoluteSize.X,height=b.AbsoluteSize.Y,invoked=invoked} assert(result.action=='Train' and result.target=='Iron Impact Dummy' and not result.eligible and result.presentation=='TwoLineCompactV2' and result.profile=='PhoneTwoLineCenterLane56V4' and result.title=='LOCKED' and result.detail:find('1.5K',1,true) and result.titleFits and result.detailFits and result.width>=196 and result.height>=52 and result.invoked,'locked context '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: locked contextual action is exact compact and readable
wait for server rejection

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local s=a:Invoke('TrainingSnapshot') return H:JSONEncode({ok=s.Power==1400 and s.active==false and s.stationId=='rookie_bag',Power=s.Power,active=s.active,stationId=s.stationId})

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local s=a:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=1499,FistMultiplier=13,PetMultiplier=0,Rebirths=0,FistMastery=1,HonorPowerBonus=0}) local t=a:Invoke('TrainingSnapshot') return H:JSONEncode({ok=s.ok==true and s.Power==1499 and t.basePower==1499 and t.qualificationPower>=1500,Power=s.Power,basePower=t.basePower,qualification=t.qualificationPower})

steps.label: reproduce public case where displayed effective Power exceeds Iron threshold
wait for eligible contextual state

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation local b=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD.ContextAction local altered=0 for _,d in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('Motor6D') or d:IsA('AnimationConstraint') then local connected=d:IsA('Motor6D') and d.Part1 or (d:IsA('AnimationConstraint') and d.Attachment1 and d.Attachment1.Parent) if d.Name=='RightShoulder' or d.Name=='Right Shoulder' or (connected and (connected.Name=='RightUpperArm' or connected.Name=='Right Arm')) then d.Name='QC Unsupported Shoulder' if d:IsA('Motor6D') then d.Part1=nil else d.Attachment1=nil end altered+=1 end end end local result={eligible=g:GetAttribute('ContextualTrainingEligible'),target=g:GetAttribute('ContextualActionTarget'),title=b.ActionTitle.Text,detail=b.ActionDetail.Text,altered=altered,invoked=a:Invoke('InvokeContextualAction')} assert(result.eligible and result.target=='Iron Impact Dummy' and result.title=='TRAIN' and result.detail:find('+40/s',1,true) and result.altered>=1 and result.invoked,'eligible context '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: exact eligible station starts through the production request path
wait for two fallback fist strikes

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local s=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation:Invoke('TrainingSnapshot') return H:JSONEncode({ok=s.active==true and s.stationId=='iron_dummy' and s.gainPerSecond==40 and s.Power>=1540,active=s.active,stationId=s.stationId,gain=s.gainPerSecond,Power=s.Power})

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local count=g:GetAttribute('TrainingFistFallbackCount') or 0 local echoes=0 for _,x in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do if x:GetAttribute('VisualRole')=='TrainingFistStrikeFallback' then echoes+=1 end end local result={ok=count>=1 and g:GetAttribute('TrainingCharacterAnimationApplied')==false and g:GetAttribute('TrainingFistFallbackEquippedFist')=='Starter Glove' and echoes<=1,count=count,characterAnimated=g:GetAttribute('TrainingCharacterAnimationApplied'),equipped=g:GetAttribute('TrainingFistFallbackEquippedFist'),echoes=echoes} assert(result.ok,'fist fallback '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: unsupported avatar visibly strikes with the equipped fist

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation a:Invoke('StopTraining') local names={'Forest Pup','Miner Cat','Crystal Fox','Lava Dragon','Secret Titan Golem','Crimson Phoenix','Storm Wyvern','Celestial Guardian'} local s=a:Invoke('SetStats',{PetInventoryJSON=H:JSONEncode(names),DiscoveredPetsJSON=H:JSONEncode(names),LockedPetsJSON='[]',EquippedPetsJSON='[]'}) local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local target=workspace.PunchWallRPG.Interactables:FindFirstChild('Hero Armory Merchant Interaction') local root=p and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') assert(root and target,'Armory runtime target') root.Anchored=true root.CFrame=CFrame.new(target.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,5)) root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero task.wait(.25) root.Anchored=false return H:JSONEncode({ok=s.ok==true,inventory=s.PetInventoryJSON,targetPosition={target.Position.X,target.Position.Y,target.Position.Z}})

steps.label: stop training and seed exact pet preview catalog
wait for exact use target scan

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation local b=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD.ContextAction local result={action=g:GetAttribute('ContextualActionName'),target=g:GetAttribute('ContextualActionTarget'),active=b.Active,title=b.ActionTitle.Text,detail=b.ActionDetail.Text,invoked=a:Invoke('InvokeContextualAction')} assert(result.action=='Use' and result.target~='' and result.active and result.title=='USE' and result.detail==string.upper(result.target) and result.invoked,'use context '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenInventory') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Pets') a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','') a:Invoke('SetInventoryRarity','All') task.wait(1) local root=g.GameMenu.FunctionalInventory local grid=root.InventoryWindow.InventoryBody.InventoryGridPane.InventoryGrid local expected={['Forest Pup']={source='Dowodle'},['Miner Cat']={source='Catmouse'},['Crystal Fox']={source='Ocelot'},['Lava Dragon']={source='Mythic Autumn Dragon'},['Secret Titan Golem']={source='Dark Guardian'},['Crimson Phoenix']={asset='86478691482535'},['Storm Wyvern']={asset='83562531232957'},['Celestial Guardian']={asset='121956330907081'}} local cards,matched,overlaps=0,0,0 local function overlap(a,b) local ap,as,bp,bs=a.AbsolutePosition,a.AbsoluteSize,b.AbsolutePosition,b.AbsoluteSize return math.max(0,math.min(ap.X+as.X,bp.X+bs.X)-math.max(ap.X,bp.X))*math.max(0,math.min(ap.Y+as.Y,bp.Y+bs.Y)-math.max(ap.Y,bp.Y)) end for _,card in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do if card:IsA('GuiObject') and card.Visible and card:GetAttribute('InventoryCategory')=='Pets' then cards+=1 local art=card:FindFirstChild('ArtFrame') local rarity=card:FindFirstChild('Rarity') local equipped=card:FindFirstChild('Equipped') local locked=card:FindFirstChild('Locked') if art and rarity then overlaps+=overlap(art,rarity) end if art and equipped and equipped.Visible then overlaps+=overlap(art,equipped) end if art and locked and locked.Visible then overlaps+=overlap(art,locked) end local name=card:GetAttribute('PreviewPetName') local vp=card:FindFirstChild('ItemPetPreview',true) local world=vp and vp:FindFirstChild('PetPreviewWorld') local model=world and world:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model') local e=expected[name] local sourceOk=e and ((e.source and model and model:GetAttribute('SourcePackModelName')==e.source) or (e.asset and model and tostring(model:GetAttribute('CreatorStoreAssetId') or model:GetAttribute('AssetId'))==e.asset)) if e and vp and vp:GetAttribute('PreviewReady')==true and sourceOk then matched+=1 end end end local result={ok=root:GetAttribute('InventoryCompactCardContentVersion')=='StatusRailV4' and cards==8 and matched==8 and overlaps<1,version=root:GetAttribute('InventoryCompactCardContentVersion'),cards=cards,matched=matched,overlaps=overlaps,cardHeight=root:GetAttribute('InventoryCardHeight'),columns=root:GetAttribute('InventoryColumns')} assert(result.ok and result.cardHeight<=94 and result.columns>=5,'Inventory pet cards '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: compact Inventory shows all pet art without tag overlap

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenTab','Premium') a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Premium') task.wait(1) local shop=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local expected={['Crimson Phoenix']='86478691482535',['Storm Wyvern']='83562531232957',['Celestial Guardian']='121956330907081'} local checked,preview,detailed=0,0,0 for _,card in ipairs(shop:GetDescendants()) do if card:IsA('Frame') and card.Name:sub(-8)=='ShopCard' and card:GetAttribute('OfferKind')=='GamePass' then local price=card:FindFirstChild('Price') local icon=card:FindFirstChild('PriceIcon') assert(price and icon and price:GetAttribute('CurrencyPalette')=='RobuxGreen' and price.TextColor3~=Color3.fromRGB(255,207,58),'Robux palette '..card.Name) checked+=1 local vp=card:FindFirstChild('PremiumPetPreview',true) local world=vp and vp:FindFirstChild('PremiumPetPreviewWorld') local model=world and world:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model') local name=vp and vp:GetAttribute('PreviewPetName') if card:GetAttribute('PremiumPetPreviewReady')==true then preview+=1 end if expected[name] and vp:GetAttribute('PreviewSource')=='ExternalTemplate' and model and tostring(model:GetAttribute('CreatorStoreAssetId') or model:GetAttribute('AssetId'))==expected[name] then detailed+=1 end end end local result={ok=checked==3 and preview==3 and detailed==3,checked=checked,preview=preview,detailed=detailed,page=shop:GetAttribute('ShopPage')} assert(result.ok,'premium shop '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)
